## Scope

- Epoch/package area:
- User-visible result:

## Compatibility

- [ ] Package schema/migration impact documented
- [ ] Stable IDs preserved or migration supplied
- [ ] Dependency lock updated where required

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run audit:release`
- [ ] Playwright desktop Chromium
- [ ] Playwright mobile Chromium
- [ ] Playwright mobile WebKit
- [ ] Relevant physical-device check recorded

## Assets and licensing

- [ ] New resources include provenance, licence, byte count and SHA-256
- [ ] No executable or imported HTML content

## Review

- [ ] Open blocking package comments resolved
- [ ] Screenshots/video attached for visual changes
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated
